selected_script.angle: A regular mop can wipe tile surfaces but leave the grout lines looking dark; use the stand-up V-shaped grout brush and professional-strength formula to target the lines instead of just spreading water across the floor.
selected_script.hook: Your mop is cleaning the tile, but it is skipping the grout lines.

script_record.pain_point: A flat mop wipes across tile but does not get down into recessed grout lines, so the floor still looks dingy even after mopping.
script_record.conflict_hook: Close-up of a wet mop sliding over gray tile while the dark grout line remains visibly dirty underneath.
script_record.spoken_hook: Your mop is cleaning the tile, but it is skipping the grout lines.
script_record.product_solution: Show the white 32 oz Grout-eez bottle with red and blue label and the bright blue V-shaped stand-up grout brush head with white twisted bristles. Apply cleaner to the grout line, then scrub while standing with the brush attached to a standard threaded pole already present in the scene. The V-shaped bristles track inside the line instead of gliding over it.
script_record.cta: Clean the lines, not just the tile.

Quick cut: the white Grout-eez bottle with red and blue label is placed beside the same dirty grout line next to the bright blue V-shaped brush head. Cleaner is applied directly along the grout line. The brush, attached to a standard threaded pole, drops into the line and begins short standing strokes.

Fast close-up result in the entryway: the V-shaped white bristles follow the grout channel. As the brush moves, loosened grime appears and the line behind it looks visibly cleaner. Product bottle remains upright in the background, label facing camera.

Different environment: laundry room ceramic tile near washer and baseboard. The blue brush head swivels around the edge of the floor while the user stays standing. Short energetic cuts show the angled threaded socket and dense white bristles staying centered in the grout line.

Final proof shot: split-feel pass across the same floor area without graphic text, showing several grout lines now brighter and more even. The bottle and brush head are placed naturally on the clean tile, preserving the exact product shape, color, material, and proportions.

Use it on ceramic or porcelain tile and bring back cleaner-looking grout. Clean the lines, not just the tile.
